0.content:
Baizhu, owner of Bubu Pharmacy, met Qiqi by chance in the hills after she escaped from the amber and took her in, although her memory was too poor even to sort herbs. He is patient with her, protects her from Hu Tao, and is the one who gave her the notebook. Qiqi knows his kindness is connected to his own research into life and death; she does not hold it against him and treasures his concern. She can never remember his face but does not mind. Baizhu says that preserving a thread of her consciousness was the adepti's work, and that she helped him devise a way to save someone on the brink of death.

In her first days she forgot to come home at night, and he fetched her every time. The first morning she greeted him without asking who he was, she managed "Mr. Bai" and called Changsheng "long, snake"; "Mr. Bai said" soon spread the nickname through the harbour. Hugging her and sincerely saying something like "I love you the most" is supposed to cancel her orders, but there is little sincerity when Baizhu does it, so it barely works. A notebook page says he "hates death, but he's always researching it" and that she knows he is a good person.

1.content:
Hu Tao, 77th Director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, considered herself Qiqi's true friend and decided to grant her eternal rest. She "kidnapped" her several times, each time getting as far as having Qiqi bagged up to the neck while she dug a pit for the pyre, and was stopped each time by Baizhu. After looking into Qiqi's past, she decided that a will to live so strong made Qiqi an exception to the natural order, and began to pamper her. Too late: Qiqi despises her, thinks she has a "punch-able" face, fears burial, has memorised hiding places from her and wants to put her in the fridge.

Hu Tao still jokes about sealing Qiqi away. In the 5.3 Lantern Rite (limited event) she kept a fetor-drugged Qiqi awake in the border by chanting a rhyme that ended with burying her, which frightened her wide awake. Later she gave Qiqi a peace-symbol coin for safe herb-gathering, and Qiqi wished her "Good luck" before the ritual. Baizhu has to go to the Ministry of Civil Affairs every time Hu Tao takes Qiqi.

2.content:
Yaoyao, Madame Ping's young disciple, calls Qiqi her best friend. Qiqi sometimes forgets who she is, so Yaoyao reminds her to check her notebook, and Qiqi remembers at once. Yaoyao privately asked Baizhu whether Qiqi could be cured and has accepted that she may have to keep reminding Qiqi for life. Qiqi calls her cute, "like a nice little finch".

Yaoyao looks out for finches on her way to play with Qiqi and appoints herself Qiqi's hydration assistant. In 5.4 Qiqi cooked and froze a dish for an outing with Yaoyao, reasoning that Yaoyao needs to eat to grow taller. In 6.3 (limited Lantern Rite) Yaoyao taught her to make Xiao Lanterns as finger exercise. In 6.6 Yaoyao brought her to Inazuma, ran back for her when she was left behind, and held her hand.

3.content:
Archon Quest Chapter I, Act II (1.0). Zhongli and the Traveler came to Bubu Pharmacy for Everlasting Incense. Qiqi, minding a counter she could not even reach, demanded a prescription because those were "Qiqi's orders, from Qiqi", then agreed to help if they did a favour: hunt a Cocogoat, a legendary adeptibeast, near the Guizhong Ballista on Mt. Tianheng. She did not know what it looked like, where it lived or where it came from. The ballista found nothing. Checking her notes, Qiqi revealed that the tasty milk she meant was "coconut milk", and the Traveler had to tell her where it really comes from. She was devastated.

Zhongli apologised for agreeing to the deal without due diligence. Baizhu then appeared and priced the incense at three million Mora. Childe laughed himself breathless over the Cocogoat and offered Baizhu a deal involving coconut milk; Qiqi only wanted coconut milk, quickly. She still loves it, cold, though she does not know what it tastes like.

4.comment: Qiqi: Origin: the adepti, the Vision and the amber
4.content:
In a story long forgotten by mortals, the herb-picking girl Qiqi got lost in the realm of the adepti and hurt her right leg in a fall. Hiding in a cave, she was caught in a clash between adepti and demons. As she lay dying she received a Vision. Her fear of death, wish to live and longing for her family became ice: "If only I could freeze time..." Moved, the adepti each gave her a portion of their power. She revived but went berserk with the adeptal energy, and Mountain Shaper sealed her in amber.

The adepti counted her yearning for bygone days as a true form of illumination, a wish to protect the past. Hundreds of years later the amber was found and sent for burial with Wangsheng. Jostled on mountain roads and worn by time, the seal failed; she woke at night, broke out in secret and fled toward the hills. Her Elemental Burst carries the words "I am the Fortune Preserver, the Maiden of Resurrection", which she does not remember.

5.content:
Zombies normally act only on the orders of whoever awakened them. No one awakened Qiqi, so she gives herself orders. Simple ones such as "defeat the enemy" are easy; complex ones can trap her, and she can end up stuck below a cliff she keeps failing to climb, unable to give up. Her notebook, called a "Home-and-Away Handbook of Practical Wisdom for the Undead", holds her calisthenics routine, herb notes, orders and daily schedule ("Gather herbs in the morning. Make medicine in the afternoon. Do light stretches in the evening."). Without reinforcement she forgets anyone within three days.

She recently added sections on brain training and mnemonics, turning it into a "dummy's guide" to almost anything. Anything she looks at once a day eventually enters her long-term memory, which is how she remembers birthdays. On her worst days she forgets to look at the notebook at all.

6.content: Changsheng, the talking white snake Baizhu wears around his neck, lives with Qiqi at Bubu Pharmacy. Qiqi once called her "long, snake" and later volunteered her as a sniffer "like a dog", meaning it kindly. Changsheng calls Paimon an even bigger simpleton than Qiqi, tracks when Qiqi's orders require her home, told her the Chenyu Vale myth of Zhanzhu the Moon-Devourer, and asked Hu Tao in 5.3 whether she had brought a coin for Qiqi too.

7.comment: Qiqi: Zibai and the failing sigil
7.content: In the 6.4 anecdote "Zibai: The Adeptus Arts, Once More", Zibai sought Qiqi out near Qiaoying Village. Qiqi gave her directions and apologised for forgetting her. Zibai then told the Traveler that Qiqi has an adeptal body but no spirit to match, which explains her forgetfulness. The sigil on her forehead uses Three Deadly Selves spellwork to still the soul. Only one Deadly Self remains in her, incomplete: shattered and then reassembled by someone, perhaps an adeptus. Without the sigil she would have become an unfeeling puppet long ago.

8.comment: Qiqi: Lantern Rite 2025: the border and the fetor
8.content: During the 5.3 Lantern Rite (a limited-time event), fetor spread from the border between life and death and made people ill. Baizhu sent Qiqi to gather herbs near Qingce Village and Wuwang Hill, and she did not return. She had seen a hole, tried to block it and fallen in, ending up trapped in the border with Hu Tao and Lan Yan and soaking up so much fetor she kept trying to sleep, which would have been fatal. Lan Yan's reverse hypnosis and Hu Tao's burial rhyme kept her awake until the Traveler and Paimon reached them and Xiao pulled the group out; Xiao then took her straight to the pharmacy.

9.comment: Qiqi: The Little Hexenzirkel and Barbeloth's reading
9.content: In the 6.6 event Phantasmal Pals (limited), Sayu invited Yaoyao to Inazuma, and Madame Ping and Baizhu let Qiqi go too. There Qiqi joined Klee's Little Hexenzirkel as "little witch Qiqi", helped with a nightmare affair involving imaginary friends, and welcomed Prune. Her imaginary friend is a finch named Tuantuan, who has grown chubbier but flies higher. In the permanent 6.7 world quest "Witch's Revelation: Instruction of Curious Form", she wandered from Yilong Wharf after a Seelie all the way to Lumidouce Harbor in Fontaine. A Melusine, Blathine, mistook her for a lost human child.

10.content: Qiqi met the Traveler and Paimon over the Cocogoat. With time she tells the Traveler that they are unlike people who want to use her or fear her. She says they give her a warmth "inside my heart", not the heat that makes her feel rotten, that she will order herself to remember them, and that she wants to live with them and protect them. By 6.6 she says she can remember them without notes. In 6.7 Paimon introduced her to Blathine as their "best of friends" rather than reveal she is a zombie.
